title: Viva Glint: survey-taking refinements to comment auto-save, a single Next button and auto-scroll
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap details, product licensing and related survey settings are supported. Minor corrections should cite the additional navigation evidence, include the question's ellipsis menu in its path, and make clear that the live-editing restriction concerns question fields rather than every survey setting.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls: Auto-expand comments input row
claims.claim: Auto-expand comments input is reached from the Viva Glint admin dashboard through Configuration > Surveys > Survey programs > program > Program Summary > Program Setup.
claims.quote: The Program Setup page is the first section in Program Summary for a Microsoft Viva Glint survey. ... Auto-expand comments input
claims.fix: Keep the path. Add https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/glint/setup/employee-raw-data-export to sources: it states that selecting the survey from Survey Programs reaches Program Summary, where Program Setup is selected. Configuration > Surveys > Survey programs is already supported by the cited Questions setup and live-survey pages.
